category: premium-account reseller (Indian: INR pricing, AllDebrid and other hosts)

free_tier.stated: No free tier. 'Alldebrid 1 month premium account 1 month premium account Available ₹500.00 30 Days Validity.' Longer AllDebrid terms are listed above and below it in the same category.
free_tier.notes: The price comes from the category listing as indexed; the live category page returned an empty shell to the reader, so this is a search-index read of the vendor's own page.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable; AllDebrid's own cap applies

egress.terms: AllDebrid's own terms, resold; the listing's speed line is generic ('Download Upto Mbps Speed For Downloading', with the number missing).

interface_detail: Web shop; the buyer activates the AllDebrid entitlement and then uses AllDebrid's own web app and API.
tooling: AllDebrid's API and community tools (rclone via WebDAV bridges, JDownloader); the reseller adds nothing technical.
chaining: A second Indian rupee route to a European debrid at ₹500/month, which undercuts the Debrid-Link reseller on entry price. It buys the same thing: an entitlement, not a service.

limits.value: manual store checkout; 30-day validity per unit

limits_note: No limit of its own; only validity is stated.
binding_note: The reseller adds no constraint; AllDebrid's fair-use and host quotas bind afterwards.

identity_cost.detail: The site advertises 'Secure Payment 256 SSL Secure Payment Gateway' but names no method on the pages read; it describes itself as 'a part of AT Solutions ... provider of cloud hosting premium accounts'. A card or Indian wallet is implied, not confirmed.

reliability_note: A shell-rendered storefront whose category page would not render to a reader; the business identity is a single line about AT Solutions and an Altis Infonet design credit, with no refund terms visible.
confidence_note: The ₹500 figure is a search-index read of the vendor's category page; the live page returned an empty shell to the reader, so it was not confirmed against rendered content. Rendering the category page in a browser would move this to documented.

evidence.proved: 'Alldebrid 1 month premium account ... Available ₹500.00 30 Days Validity' (search-index read; live page returned an empty shell)
'www.premiuminrupees.com is a part of AT Solutions. It is a world leading provider of cloud hosting premium accounts'; 'Secure Payment 256 SSL Secure Payment Gateway'
the earlier product listing returned an 788-byte shell with no prices; recorded so the failed route is visible

notes: Kept despite the weaker rung because it sets the Indian price floor: ₹500/month for a full multi-hoster is cheaper than paying AllDebrid in euros at list. The caveat is the rung, not the price.
